verdict.en: OpenAI’s official skill catalog and examples.
verdict.zh: OpenAI 官方 Skills 目录与范例。

summary.en: Reusable instructions and workflows that teach Codex how to handle specialized work.
summary.zh: 用可复用的说明和工作流，让 Codex 稳定完成特定任务。

verdict.zh: Anthropic 官方 Skills 参考实现。

summary.en: Examples and reusable capabilities for extending Claude and compatible agents.
summary.zh: 用于扩展 Claude 及兼容 Agent 的示例与可复用能力。

verdict.zh: MCP 官方参考服务集合。

summary.en: A maintained starting point for connecting agents to files, data and external services.
summary.zh: 把 Agent 接入文件、数据和外部服务时的可靠起点。

verdict.zh: 让 Agent 真正使用浏览器。

summary.en: An open-source library for building agents that can navigate and operate websites.
summary.zh: 用于构建可浏览和操作网站的 Agent 的开源库。

verdict.en: A community index of Claude Code extensions.
verdict.zh: Claude Code 社区生态与扩展索引。

summary.en: A curated collection of skills, agents, plugins and developer tooling.
summary.zh: 集中整理 Skills、Agent、插件和开发者工具。

verdict.en: A portable skill collection that guides coding agents toward more deliberate frontend layout, typography, spacing, and motion.
verdict.zh: 一套可移植的技能集合，用于引导编程智能体更审慎地处理前端布局、排版、间距与动效。

summary.en: Taste Skill provides reusable agent instructions for designing and implementing less generic web interfaces, along with optional image-generation skills for visual reference boards. It is useful when working with coding agents such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code on frontend design and implementation.
summary.zh: Taste Skill 提供可复用的智能体指令，帮助设计和实现更具辨识度的 Web 界面，并包含用于生成视觉参考板的可选图像技能。它适合配合 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 等编程智能体进行前端设计与实现。
